items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: We had a band together, me and Dink Stewart, Dink, Shreeport.

ctx.x: There's another Dink from Shreeport, you know, he's in Chicago now, Dink Stewart. What did he play? He's a tenor, D tenor sax player, and his brother was a man named Cliff. We had a band together, me and Dink Stewart, Dink, Shreeport.
Well, back to the Pacific band, what kind of jobs would they play?
